name: Fast Frame Windows
description: Measures how many frames you had for every click, fast. Record a run or import a .gdr2 macro, then watch it play back with rings, numbers and sounds.

record.name: Record runs
record.description: Keep a record of your clicks and the game state around them while you play, so a run can be analyzed from the pause menu. Turn this off if you do not use the mod.

max-window.name: Largest window measured
max-window.description: How many frames earlier and later each click is tested, at most. Higher values take a little longer.

lookahead.name: Look-ahead frames
lookahead.description: How long after a click the player has to survive for the click to count. Longer is stricter and slower.

scan-from.name: Analyse from (%)
scan-from.description: Start measuring at this point of the run. Use it to check just one part.

scan-to.name: Analyse up to (%)
scan-to.description: Stop measuring at this point of the run.

show-level.name: Show level during analysis
show-level.description: Keep the level visible behind a small progress bar instead of covering the screen.

auto-playback.name: Play the level after analyzing
auto-playback.description: As soon as the analysis finishes, play the run back with the rings, numbers and sounds.

show-labels.name: Show number in level
show-labels.description: Show the window size above every click during playback.

label-size.name: Number size
label-size.description: Size of the number shown on every click.

label-time.name: Display time (seconds)
label-time.description: How long the number stays on screen.

show-ring.name: Show ring
show-ring.description: Show a ring around the player on every click during playback.

ring-colors.name: Ring colors
ring-colors.description: Red to blue colors tight windows red and roomy ones blue. The other options color by which side has more room, or use white.

show-overview.name: Show overview
show-overview.description: Show how many clicks had each window size in the top left during playback.

show-up-to.name: Largest window shown
show-up-to.description: Windows bigger than this get no ring, number or sound and are left out of the overview.

hidden-windows.name: Hidden window sizes
hidden-windows.description: Window sizes to hide, separated by commas, for example 9, 10, 11.

sound-enabled.name: Sound on every click
sound-enabled.description: Play a bell on every click during playback. Tight windows sound higher.

sound-volume.name: Sound volume
sound-volume.description: How loud the click sound is.

sound-up-to.name: Sound up to window size
sound-up-to.description: Only clicks with a window this size or smaller make a sound.
